title: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road
h1: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front- Private beach access- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas (Service provided Mar 1–Oct 31)- Professionally decorated- 6 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy the coastal elegance and beachfront luxury of “Our Southern Charm!" This gorgeous, gulf-facing home offers 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 2 kitchens, 2 living rooms, stunning interiors, private beach access, breathtaking panoramic Emerald Coast views, and incredible accommodations for 18 guests!Guests are welcomed into the home’s main level with a jewel-toned ocean view, lots of natural light, and soft, neutral décor elements. The open layout seamlessly connects the main living, dining, and kitchen areas. Professionally decorated interiors create a warm and inviting ambiance and set the stage for a relaxing getaway. The living room’s plush furnishings make the perfect place to sink down in front of the mounted flat-screen television. Bright white cabinets and a white tile backsplash amplify the natural light in the gorgeous kitchen. The chefs in your group will undoubtedly love preparing fresh, coastal meals in this space, which offers top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a beautiful farmhouse sink, and lots of countertop space. The breakfast bar creates the perfect place for others to gather over appetizers and entertain the cooks as they work. Guests can enjoy 3 seats at the breakfast bar and 6 additional seats at the adjacent dining table.Sliding glass doors lead to the spacious back deck, which provides a place to enjoy the rejuvenating beach views with a morning coffee or a favorite evening cocktail. This level offers 3 gorgeous bedrooms with various sleeping accommodations that are sure to please everyone in your group. Guests in the primary suite will enjoy a plush queen bed, a mounted flat-screen television, beach views and direct access to the back deck, and a private bathroom with a shower and a dual-sink vanity. The second guest room offers a luxurious queen bed and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final bedroom on this level features a cozy queen bed, a built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo.The second level features a similar layout to the first floor. This space offers an open-concept floor plan, a fully furnished living area with a large flat-screen television, a full-size kitchen with bright white cabinetry and premium stainless steel appliances, and a spacious dining table. Sliding glass doors lead to an expansive deck with stairs to lead to direct beach access.Three beautiful bedrooms also await on the second level. The first offers a cozy queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests can also choose between two king bed guest rooms, both utilizing a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final guest room area is the spacious and airy loft, which features 4 twin beds, 4 plush chairs, a flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a shower.This home’s prime location right on the beach allows your family to enjoy the sugar-white sand and sparkling emerald waters from sunrise to sunset.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Loft Area: Four Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
